title: AI-Powered Network O&M, Ensuring Uninterrupted Network During Power Rationing
summary: MTN attributes lower packet loss and delay to AI-assisted operations combined with network-routing changes, without isolating the model’s contribution.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: A transformer telecom model supports diagnosis, natural-language queries, and optimization recommendations within a system that also uses conventional network maps and routing methods. The source reports lower packet loss and delay at MTN, without separating the AI contribution or giving an effect size. The deployment setting is unclear: the account describes both an MTN deployment and an internal testbed.
purpose: Use model-assisted diagnosis and recommendations to improve network operation during power rationing.
system: AI-Powered Network O&M, Ensuring Uninterrupted Network During Power Rationing

ratings.reason: The source attributes lower packet loss and delay to the combined AI-assisted operational system. AI supports diagnosis and recommendations, but its share of the improvement is not separately measured.
Better user experience is claimed, but specific personal outcomes remain unreported.
Wider connectivity inclusion through improved service remains intended and is not established by the operational claim.
